thread:
maria: Heads up — int8 canary (raven-lite v2 PTQ) is spiking on funcall JSON parse failures. Baseline ~0.2% -> now ~3.1% on a 10k sample. Any quick ideas?
josh: Do we have concrete examples? paste one if you can.
maria: sure, quick paste from logs (two variants we saw):
```
Malformed: {"action": "search", "args": {"q": "socks", }
Truncated: {"action": "order", "args": {"id": "12345"}
}
```
vikram: looks like trailing comma + suffix/noise. Is streaming enabled or stop tokens missing? kvprefix? batching?
maria: streaming=true, stop token unset, batch=16, kvprefix=on for this canary to emulate prod routing.
ella: short-term mitigation: add a JSON-rescue postprocess before marking funcall failed (we have a small shim `json_rescue` that tries repairs). Longer-term: try int8 with a trailing sentinel token or reduce kvprefix.
josh: Also run the same prompt set on fp16 (no PTQ) to isolate quantization impact.
maria: ran fp16 sample: parse fails ~0.25% (same workload). So feels like PTQ introduced suffix noise.
vikram: ok likely PTQ decoder jitter. Plan: A/B test int8 vs fp16 vs int8+sentinel. Also toggle `--streaming=false` and `kvprefix=off` to see if interleaving is culprit.
deploy-bot: Canary job started for raven-lite v2 (int8) on pool-3 — job_id=canary-1789994000
ella: operational plan: 1) pause rollout for customer route; 2) rollback to fp16 on prod-facing pool; 3) run microbench: tokenization + attention trace with seed to reproduce; 4) run int8+sentinel microcanary and a small eval that checks strict JSON compliance; 5) add funcall_parse metric to canary dashboards.
josh: I can run the microbench and post results in ~2h. For immediate runbook, let's add middleware `retry_with_float` (attempt one retry on float variant before surfacing failure) and set retry budget=1, backoff=200ms.
maria: adding rollout hold and filing a quick incident note to product.
vikram: experiment commands I'll run:
```bash
# disable streaming + kvprefix off
rw-canary run --model raven-lite:v2-int8 --streaming=false --kvprefix=off --sample 500 --tag parse-check
# int8 with sentinel
rw-canary run --model raven-lite:v2-int8 --prompt-suffix "\n###END###" --sample 500 --tag sentinel-check
```
ella: also add a lightweight postprocess that attempts to close open braces and remove trailing commas before invoking json.loads — cheap and often fixes 70-80% repairable cases. We'll gate it behind a flag so we can measure how many cases are repaired vs true model bug.
maria: good — please add telemetry: original_parse_failed, repaired_by_postproc, retried_on_float, final_nonparse.
josh: question: do we want to reduce batch size for canary to 4 while debugging? might change latency but reduces batching-induced token interleave.
vikram: yes reduce to 4 for debug runs. we'll snapshot latency separately.
maria: I'm posting sample traces to the canary S3 prefix now (s3://redwood-canary/raven-lite/1789994321/) — will update when uploads complete.
ella: after we get microbench, if int8 still fails under kvprefix=off and streaming=false then this is a core PTQ decoder issue and we should escalate to research for quant kernel audit.
josh: noted. I'll kick off fp16 vs int8 microbench now.
maria: thanks team. tagging @vikram for the followups and @ella for the postprocess patch. :thumbsup:
